item.title: PRC releases November and December 2025 DLE Dentist results today
item.description: DLE RESULTS – RESULTS ARE OUT! The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announced on Friday that 1,282 out of 1,474 (86.97%) passed the November and December 2025 Dentist Licensure Exam (DLE). PRC conducted the Dentist board exam Written Phase in Manila, Baguio, Cebu, and Davao on November 24, 25, and 26, 2025 while the Practical Phase was conducted on December 1–6, 2025 in Manila. item.title: FULL RESULTS: November and December 2025 DLE Dentist board exam passers, top 10
item.description: DLE RESULTS — The full results of December 2025 Dentist Licensure Exam (DLE), including the list of passers, topnotchers (top 10), top performing school and performance of schools, are released by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) on Friday, December 12, 2025, four (4) working days after the exam.
